sections.title: Introduction
sections.description:
Welcome to Vublox Limited (“Vublox”, “we”, “us” and “our”). These Terms and Conditions (“Terms”) govern your use of our website, mobile applications, and other services we provide (collectively referred to as the “Platform”). By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to comply with and be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, you must immediately cease using the Platform.

Vublox is a social platform designed to democratize historical events by allowing users to contribute, share, and engage with content related to past occurrences. Our mission is to provide a space where history is preserved and discussed freely. However, the use of Vublox is subject to the following terms and conditions, which are set forth to ensure the safety, legality, and integrity of the platform.
